description: This file is a CMake script designed to locate and configure the bcm_host library for the build system. It checks for the library's presence, sets relevant variables, and defines an imported target if found.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates and loads the specified package, in this case, 'PkgConfig' and 'FindPackageHandleStandardArgs'.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of the specified module, here 'bcm_host', and sets related variables.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds the library file for 'bcm_host' with hints from specified directories.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other CMake modules, such as 'FindPackageHandleStandardArgs'.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard arguments for package finding, setting success or failure flags.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in GUIs.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines an imported library target for 'BCM_HOST::BCM_HOST'.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for the imported target, such as location and compile options.
